question: which jobs this week haven't had invoices created for them
gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(wo.work_number, wo.id) AS job, c.name FROM work_orders wo JOIN customers c ON c.id = wo.customer_id WHERE wo.bill_id IS NULL AND YEARWEEK(wo.created_at, 1) = YEARWEEK('2026-06-16', 1)
